requirement: Add live-daemon compatibility protection so recovery cannot call an old daemon /spawn-session that ignores resumeSessionId and accidentally creates new sessions instead of resuming.

evidence.prod_dist_spawn_session_schema: /root/happy/packages/happy-cli/dist/index-WGnVoqay.mjs /spawn-session body accepts directory and sessionId only, while source fix adds resumeSessionId.
evidence.risk: Current /root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh posts resumeSessionId; an old live daemon may strip/ignore the field and start a new session, then /list verification by Happy session id could falsely pass.

constraints: Do not reboot, stop, restart, reload, or kill live services/sessions.
Make unsupported live daemon fail closed before spawning.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery preflights live daemon support for resumeSessionId before POSTing /spawn-session.
If support cannot be proven, recovery does not spawn and logs a clear failure requiring CLI build/restart via sanctioned SOP.
After daemon spawn, /list verification must prove returned row maps to requested resume id where available, not just any Happy session id.
QA can verify statically and with safe checks only.
